verdict.rationale: Aliases or masked addresses are a fair question for an email product, since some clients ship send-as aliases or masking. Nothing in the pack shows Superhuman Mail offering either. The evidence covers AI labeling, drafts, calendar, snippets, team features and MCP, which are unrelated to hiding a user's real address. Community privacy discussion concerns read-tracking and server storage, not aliasing.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can use aliases or masked addresses so sign-ups and strangers never learn my real address
